rls-criteria.l: An urge to move the legs, usually with an uncomfortable sensation in them
It begins or worsens during rest or inactivity
It is relieved by movement, for as long as the movement continues
It is worse in the evening or at night than during the day
It is not better accounted for by another condition such as leg cramps
The symptoms cause distress or interfere with sleep or functioning
On average at least twice a week over the past year
Otherwise, at least five events in a lifetime
